updates.note: Management reiterated aspiration to reach $2 billion by March 2027.
updates.quote: we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027

new_promises.statement: We have an aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31.
new_promises.quote: our long-term aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31
new_promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

new_promises.statement: Effective Tax Rate for FY26 will be in the range of 20% to 24%.
new_promises.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
new_promises.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
